string.text: Not Left 4 Dead
Mod Enabled
Master toggle to enable or disable Not Left 4 Dead battle aftermath survivor spawns.
Survivor Relation Bonus
Relation bonus awarded with the survivor upon rescuing and recruiting them (default: 100).
Use Custom Name & Epithet Pool
When enabled, survivors receive culture-appropriate gritty names and survivor epithets (defined in config.json).
Spawn & Battle Size
Minimum Base Spawn Chance
Base probability of finding a survivor in the smallest qualifying battle (default: 15%).
Guaranteed Casualty Threshold
Total battle casualties (killed + wounded) at which survivor discovery chance reaches 100% (default: 1500).
Spawn Chance Multiplier
Overall multiplier applied to survivor spawn probability calculation.
Winning Side Survivor Weight
Probability that a survivor originates from the winning army instead of the defeated side when both sides had Lords (default: 35%).
Companion & Pool Rules
Allow Exceeding Companion Limit
If enabled, you can recruit battlefield survivors even if your clan has reached its companion capacity.
Max Unrecruited Survivors (World FIFO Cap)
Maximum number of unrecruited survivors wandering the realm. Spawning a new survivor past this limit removes the oldest unrecruited survivor (default: 5).
Initial Wounded HP Ratio Min
Minimum initial health ratio for newly spawned wounded survivors (default: 15%).
Initial Wounded HP Ratio Max
Maximum initial health ratio for newly spawned wounded survivors (default: 20%).
Force Spawn (Debug)
Forces a survivor to spawn after ANY qualifying battle regardless of size or probability.

{HERO_NAME} fought under the banner of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} ({SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME}) in a brutal clash against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} ({ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}) that claimed {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties. Left for dead in the wreckage, {HERO_NAME} was rescued by {PLAYER_LINK}.

I was a loyal retainer of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}. When {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} forces crashed upon us, he fled without a second thought, leaving me here bleeding among the dead. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I have been lying here waiting for the vultures.

My lord {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} ordered us to hold the line, but the moment {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} broke our flanks, he retreated instantly. The {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} cut us down to the last man; I survived only by feigning death beneath a pile of corpses.

The rout was a complete disaster. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} sacrificed our rearguard to {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} and the {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} host to save his own skin. I have been stranded here for {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours with a shattered shield.

Even in victory against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} army, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s forces moved too fast during the pursuit and left the wounded behind in the mud. I've crawled miles since the battle ended.
We won the field against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}, but {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} was so eager to claim the plunder that my battalion's wounded were forgotten in the chaos. I've been stranded here ever since.

The victory celebrations over {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s defeat started miles away while I lay pinned beneath my dead horse. {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s vanguard didn't even bother to sweep the field for survivors.
Our transport ship splintered into matchwood when {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} rams struck. I washed ashore clinging to a broken spar after hours adrift in the freezing surf.

The naval skirmish against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} fleet was a bloodbath. When our galley went down, I was dragged under by the drowning men and barely clawed my way up onto these rocky shores.
What actually happened here? Tell me of the battle.
Who are you really? What is your story?
What happened to you? How bad are your wounds?

{SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s {SURVIVOR_FACTION_NAME} host clashed fiercely with {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} forces near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. The battle was a slaughter from the start, leaving {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} dead and wounded before {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} sounded the retreat and abandoned the fallen.

We engaged {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} ({ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}) under the command of {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} right outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. When our center collapsed under {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s charge, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} ordered an immediate rout, leaving {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} men behind to be slaughtered.

Near the walls of {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} and {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} fought a brutal engagement. Over {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} souls fell in the carnage, and when defeat became certain, {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} fled without looking back.

{SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} completely crushed {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} army near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Though we won, it cost {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties, and {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} marched off with the plunder while leaving crippled veterans behind in the mud.

It was a glorious triumph over {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} forces outside {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. But glory has a price of {BATTLE_CASUALTIES} casualties, and {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} cared more for the spoils than collecting the wounded.

We broke {ENEMY_LORD_NAME} ({ENEMY_FACTION_NAME}) in a decisive struggle near {NEAREST_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Total casualties reached {BATTLE_CASUALTIES}, but {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s pursuit was so reckless that the rearguard was entirely forgotten.

I am {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}, born within the walls of {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. Raised in the traditions of {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} warfare, I swore an oath of loyalty to {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}, believing noble lords valued honor above all.
They call me {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}. My home was {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}, and I was trained in {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} discipline before taking service under {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}.
My name is {SURVIVOR_FULL_NAME}, originating from {BORN_SETTLEMENT_NAME}. As a proud {SURVIVOR_CULTURE_NAME} warrior, I pledged my sword to {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}, never expecting betrayal.

I took a severe blow during {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}'s assault. For {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours I lay pinned beneath corpses and shattered shields, listening to looters while {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME}'s banners vanished over the ridge.
The {ENEMY_FACTION_NAME} cavalry trampled me into the dirt. I have survived for {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours by sheer willpower, waiting while {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} cared nothing for my fate.
A spear thrust pierced my armor early in the fight against {ENEMY_LORD_NAME}. I crawled into a ditch and endured {HOURS_SINCE_BATTLE} hours of agony while {SURVIVOR_LORD_NAME} retreated safely.
You found me just in time. I will never forget this mercy (Relation +{SURVIVOR_RELATION}). Take me with you, and my blade is yours.
Agreed. Rise and join my company.
You must find your own way to the nearest town.
Thank you, captain. I live to fight another day under your banner.
As you wish... I will try to make my way to {TARGET_TOWN_NAME} on foot.
I haven't forgotten how you pulled me from the jaws of death, and I never will, captain. I am ready to join your ranks for good.
Certainly, we will accomplish great things together. Come with me.
Unfortunately, I still have no place for you right now.
An honor, captain! Let us march.
Understood. I will wait here in the tavern until you have need of me.
